text.en: Clients describe the daycare as a fantastic and secure environment where high-energy dogs can socialize and play safely. Pet parents appreciate that their companions spend energetic hours with canine friends before returning home pleasantly tired. Reviewers consider the location a dependable second home for regular daytime pet supervision.

title.en: Support for rescues and active dogs

text.en: Pet owners highlight that energetic puppies and nervous rescue dogs alike receive patient and enriching care. Clients with rescue dogs note that fearful pets quickly gained confidence and developed an eagerness to attend daycare sessions. Families appreciate receiving happier, more balanced companions after each day of play and socialization.

Pet guardians commend Aidan and the entire team for their genuine love of working with dogs and their accommodating communication. Reviewers note that staff handle diverse temperaments skillfully, putting anxious owners at ease from the first visit. Clients express lasting gratitude for the staff's dedication and warm hospitality.

q.en: Is Collins Canines suitable for high-energy dogs?

a.en: Yes, clients note that high-energy breeds get plenty of exercise and playtime, returning home relaxed and content.

q.en: Can anxious or rescue dogs attend the daycare?

a.en: Reviewers report that nervous rescue dogs are handled with patience and quickly gain confidence around staff and other pets.

q.en: Does the facility provide grooming services alongside daycare?

a.en: Yes, clients mention using Collins Canines for both doggy daycare sessions and pet grooming services.

q.en: Who leads the team at Collins Canines?

a.en: Clients specifically mention Aidan and the daycare team for their enthusiastic, attentive, and caring approach to dogs.
